title: ant CLI — Official Anthropic Claude API Command-Line Tool
description: Official CLI tool (`ant`) for interacting with the Claude API from the terminal. Provides `resource action` command pattern for every API endpoint, YAML/JSON file input instead of hand-written JSON, `--transform` GJSON path output filtering, automatic list pagination, `@file` inline references, and native Claude Code integration. Claude Code understands how to use `ant` out of the box — developers can ask Claude Code to list agent sessions, upload files, and query events without custom integration code. Supports YAML-based API resource versioning for git-tracked agent/environment/skill definitions (CI/CD friendly). Beta resources (agents, sessions, environments) under `beta:` prefix with auto-injected beta headers. Announced April 8, 2026.
redundancy_check: NOVEL — the `claude` CLI runs Claude Code sessions; `ant` targets the Claude API directly (agents, sessions, environments, messages). No existing capability for API resource management from the terminal with YAML versioning.
notes: Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (Max plan has keychain auth via `claude` CLI, but `ant` uses env var). Check if Max plan keychain can be leveraged or if API key must be set separately. Claude Code integration is native — 'Claude Code understands how to use ant out of the box'. Highly relevant to managed-agents workflows. Install: `curl` to Linux binary or `brew install anthropics/tap/ant`.

evaluation.reasoning: Research confirmed (2026-04-15): `ant` CLI strictly requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var. Max plan keychain credentials (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN) do NOT work — ant uses X-Api-Key header path, not OAuth bearer. Every `ant` call is billed at API token rates; Max plan subscription does not cover it. Integration complexity = 0 (impossible for Max plan users without purchasing a separate API subscription). Capability expansion revised to 40 (genuinely novel YAML versioning is real, but zero value if we can't access it). Despite official Anthropic status (community_validation=95), the auth blocker makes integration impossible for our current setup. REJECTED: revisit if Max plan adds API key issuance or `ant` gains OAuth support.
research_questions: Future: Does Anthropic add OAuth/keychain support to `ant`, making it accessible on Max plan without separate billing?
evaluation.research_note: 2026-04-15: RESOLVED. Confirmed via official docs and GitHub issue #39903 — ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is strictly required, Max plan keychain bypassed. No workaround available. Previous NEEDS_RESEARCH blocker is now a confirmed rejection blocker.
